evidence: src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/script/script.h optimize witness deserialization and defer witness stack materialization in VerifyWitnessProgram.
rationale: Reduces validation CPU overhead and adversarial DoS exposure on blocks with extreme witness counts. Benchmarks show deserializing blocks with millions of 1-byte elements becomes 'about 10x faster' and total verification time drops from 185ms to 14ms.
